title: Dogalog — a real-time, Prolog-based livecoding music environment  #github

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Dogalog, a real-time prologuebased live coding music environment where you write logic rules to generate rhythms and melodies. Instead of traditional sequencers, Dogalog lets you live code music using logic programming, change the rules, and the sound updates instantly.
